funding.name: College Reconnect (Missouri)
funding.provider: Missouri Department of Higher Education and Workforce Development
funding.provides: Statewide effort to identify adults with some college experience but no credential and support their return to higher education.

funding.name: Fast Track Workforce Incentive Grant (Missouri)
funding.provider: Missouri Department of Higher Education and Workforce Development
funding.provides: Financial aid program that encourages adults to pursue a certificate, degree or industry-recognized credential in an area designated as high need.
funding.how_to_apply: Application is available electronically in the State Financial Aid Portal.

funding.name: A+ Scholarship Program (Missouri)
funding.provider: Missouri Department of Higher Education and Workforce Development
funding.provides: Merit-based scholarship for eligible graduates of A+ designated high schools who attend participating public community colleges or vocational/technical schools, or certain private two-year vocational schools.
funding.eligibility: Eligible graduates of A+ designated high schools; page information is for the 2026-2027 academic year.

funding.name: Access Missouri Financial Assistance Program
funding.provider: Missouri Department of Higher Education and Workforce Development
funding.provides: Need-based program with predictable awards based on the Student Aid Index from the FAFSA, for use at participating Missouri schools.
funding.eligibility: U.S. citizen or permanent resident and Missouri resident; undergraduate enrolled full time at a participating Missouri school (initial students, per the page).

funding.name: Bright Flight Scholarship (Missouri)
funding.provider: Missouri Department of Higher Education and Workforce Development
funding.provides: Merit-based scholarship for top-ranked high school seniors who attend approved Missouri postsecondary schools.
funding.eligibility: Missouri resident and U.S. citizen or permanent resident; ACT or SAT composite within the top five percent of Missouri test takers.

funding.name: Kids' Chance Scholarship Program (Missouri)
funding.provider: Missouri Department of Higher Education and Workforce Development
funding.provides: Scholarship for children of workers seriously injured or killed in a work-related accident covered by workers' compensation.
funding.eligibility: Children of workers seriously injured or killed in a compensated work-related accident, verified with the Division of Workers' Compensation.

funding.name: Apprenticeship Missouri
funding.provider: Missouri Department of Higher Education and Workforce Development
funding.provides: Works with employers, providers and partners to build a skilled workforce through registered apprenticeship and work-based learning.

funding.name: Missouri Apprentice Connect
funding.provider: Missouri Department of Higher Education and Workforce Development
funding.provides: Missouri site for potential apprentices, training providers, employers and the business community to connect on registered apprenticeships.

funding.name: Missouri Registered Apprenticeships (JobsMoGov)
funding.provider: Missouri Department of Higher Education and Workforce Development (JobsMoGov)
funding.provides: Describes registered apprenticeships as paid jobs with occupation-related instruction, where apprentices receive higher wages as they build skills.

funding.name: Trade Adjustment Assistance (Missouri)
funding.provider: Missouri Department of Higher Education and Workforce Development (JobsMoGov)
funding.provides: Federal Trade Act program in Missouri; the page says the TAA program expired July 1, 2022 and only workers certified on or before June 30, 2022 and separated by that date may continue to receive benefits.
funding.eligibility: Workers covered by petitions certified on or before June 30, 2022 and separated from employment on or before June 30, 2022.
